label: SMILES from Wikidata for metabolites of a species
description: Retrieve metabolites (with InChIKey and SMILES) from pathways that have a specific species annotated at the DataNode level, enriched via Wikidata federated query. Species filtering uses graph/gpml-taxonomy-extra + graph/ncbitaxon (NOT wp:organismName, which only returns "Viridiplantae" at pathway level).
